emergency_calls.site_address: Villa 13, Building 2373, Road 2831, Al Seef, Block 428, Bahrain
emergency_calls.emergency_type: Main Fire Pump Controller Malfunction & Pressure Bleed
emergency_calls.emergency_description: Night emergency callout: Main electric jockey pump cycling continuously every 40 seconds; fire pump controller sounding alarm and displaying low header pressure warning.
emergency_calls.reported_problem: FACP annunciator panel displaying fire pump trouble alarm; jockey pump failing to maintain system pressure above cut-in setpoint of 7.5 bar.
emergency_calls.findings: Ruptured 1-inch pressure sensing brass fitting on jockey pump discharge line; vibration-induced fatigue failure causing rapid pressure loss. Sensing line strainer clogged with scale.
emergency_calls.cause: Mechanical fatigue on rigid connector without pulsation dampening, combined with pipe sediment accumulation.
emergency_calls.action_taken: Isolated jockey pump lines. Replaced damaged rigid fitting with stainless steel braided high-pressure flexible loop with pulsation snubber. Flushed strainer and recalibrated cut-in/cut-out settings.
emergency_calls.rectification: Re-pressurized system to 8.8 bar. Tested 3 automatic start/stop cycles successfully. Verified standby diesel pump auto-crank signal. Cleared panel alarms.
emergency_calls.recommendations: Inspect primary non-return check valve during next quarterly AMC inspection.
emergency_calls.customer_remarks: Urgent response within 30 minutes in early morning. Noise and pressure alarm resolved completely.
emergency_calls.technician_remarks: Pump room left clean and in 100% normal automatic operating mode.
emergency_calls.supervisor_remarks: Civil Defence and NFPA 20 compliance verified. Work inspected and approved.

emergency_calls.emergency_type: Smoke Detector Loop Fault & False Alarms
emergency_calls.emergency_description: Intermittent false alarms in Administration Corridor. Loop 2 reporting communication dropouts.
emergency_calls.reported_problem: Strobes and sounders triggered unexpectedly during school hours without fire condition.
emergency_calls.findings: Device #42 in Server Corridor contaminated with AC maintenance dust particles causing analog voltage spike.
emergency_calls.cause: Fine particulates settling on internal optical sensing chamber.
emergency_calls.action_taken: Isolated zone alarm outputs. Cleaned optical chamber with compressed gas and recalibrated baseline.
emergency_calls.rectification: Replaced head with spare XP95 detector and conducted aerosol canister smoke test. Re-enabled outputs.

emergency_calls.recommendations: Advise AC duct contractor to cover detectors during plenum cleaning.
emergency_calls.customer_remarks: Technician responded immediately and silenced the false alarm.
emergency_calls.technician_remarks: Loop 2 now communicating 100% normal with zero polling errors.
